summary: CWE-336 (Same Seed in PRNG): bad() seeded a SecureRandom with a hardcoded, constant byte array via setSeed(SEED), making the generated sequence fully predictable. The fix removes the fixed-seed material and the setSeed call so the SecureRandom relies on its secure internal self-seeding. The feature is preserved: two random integers are still generated and written.
